release_notes.headline_external: Create reviews from CSV/JSON/JSONL files for large batches
highlights: Agents can pass a local file path (source) instead of inline items — one MCP call regardless of batch size
Supports CSV (first-column-per-row), JSON (array of strings), JSONL (one string per line)
Works for all list-based surfaces: gallery, pairwise, queue, checklist, form
Backward compatible — inline items still work when source is absent
Local files only (no URL fetch); all errors return typed INVALID_REQUEST
